newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 9-MTH HOTEL, RESTAURANT SALES YP 2.6 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 9-MTH HOTEL, RESTAURANT SALES YP 2.6 PCT.

text.p: The value of sales in the Finnish hotel and restaurant branch increased 2.6 percent year-on-year in January-September, the Hotel and Restaurant Council said in a statement on Monday.
The volume rose 1.5 percent, it said.
The value of restaurant sales fell 0.9 percent year-on-year in September but January-September restaurant sales were still up 2.2 percent compared to the year-ago period.
The value of hotel accomodation sales rose 7.4 percent year-on-year in September and the January-September increase was 4.8 percent, the council said.
The number of hotel rooms sold rose 3.2 year-on-year in September while the change for the first nine-months was a one percent increase.
Hotels' occupancy rate rose to 51.1 percent, up 1.5 percentage points from the same period last year. In January-September, the rate was unchanged year-on-year at 47.1 percent, it said.
